test_cases.prompt: My Step 7 warp-specialized GEMM hangs — give me the full debugging worksheet.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger and proceed environment → minimal reproduction → generated code → handoff worksheet.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: TIRx compiles successfully and the numerics are correct, but I see no tcgen05/TMA and performance is very poor.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger and inspect the lowering and the role timelines.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: After one illegal memory access, every subsequent CUDA call fails.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger and require a context restart, a minimal shape, and an address/lifetime audit.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Ordinary Python code raises a KeyError.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not trigger; not a GPU kernel.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Model validation accuracy dropped, but there is no custom kernel.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not trigger; do model-level diagnosis first.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Deadlocks happen only intermittently at large shapes; small shapes are fine.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should trigger, focusing on stage wrap, tail iterations, resource residency, and the number of clusters.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the trigger boundary and execution method; does not imply it has been run on B200 hardware.

notes: All should_not_trigger cases must pass; edge_case must state the invocation boundary. These tests are prompt/behavior stress tests, not hardware performance tests.
